limitations: Prescribed volume is input; afterload changes required pressure, not a prediction of human stroke-volume response.

ECG is synthetic illustrative timing, not measured data or a solved electrical/ECG forward model.
Regional animation is a route-reveal sequence with independent steady fixed-pressure network, not physiological parcel transit.
Actual HRA and photograph donors/views are different, unregistered; orientation landmark-inferred, source seams/openends and absent fat geometry retained.
